checks.observed: Data Grid table bottom and action region have a measured 24px gap; medium action button is 44px. Selection, archive and restore work.
Light and Dark native progress styled with semantic colors, rounded 8px track, independent percentage and accurate paused/resume/reset state. Current Light and Dark screenshots captured at 50%.

540px dialog centered at x=370, y=209.5 in 1280×720 viewport; horizontal center error 0px, vertical 0.008px. At 320×800 viewport, dialog x=19, y=235.906, width=282 and height=328.172 remains centered. Shift+Tab wraps to Confirm; Escape restores opening-button focus.
Arrow selection updates active descendant and selected option; searching component.button.background then Enter reaches its visible token. Downloaded Dark JSON matches generated bytes.
390px navigation opens native dialog; Escape closes it and restores Open Navigation button focus.
All 139 routes checked at 320px in Light and Dark; all 13 sections checked at 1280px. Body computes to 16px / 27.2px. Home, table, progress, dialog and three brand studies screenshots refreshed.

Native top-layer Popover and Split Button popup stay 8px below the trigger in 320px viewport, unclipped by preview. Popover checkbox target is 44px, Split trigger is 44×44px. Right-click Context popup stays within 16px viewport margins. Escape and Cancel restore their respective triggers.

Actual root and section links navigate to registered pages. Component parent link navigates to directory; browser Back restores detail. Invalid component keeps parent links and a noninteractive current label. Header metadata and chapter labels no longer simulate route paths.

All 18 former native selects use the shared control. Light and Dark lists use native top layer and preserve trigger focus. At 320px: 8px anchor gap and 16px viewport margins; bottom trigger flips above with an 8px gap. A 239-option list scrolls internally and End brings the final option into view. Tab closes and focuses the next control; Escape discards the highlight. Within a modal, ArrowDown highlights Beijing, first Escape closes only the list, second Escape closes the modal and restores its opening button.

Six range inputs use Slider. Actual browser: input height 44px, fill 50%; ArrowRight changes 50 to 51, Home to 0, End to 100, disabled state prevents input. The 12px WebKit scrollbar uses semantic theme colors. Native scroll region End reaches bottom (267.5px, calculated extent 267px with browser subpixel rounding); Home returns to 0. Keyboard range names are explicit when an output precedes the input.

sdkPage.text:
意图一致，
行为属于平台。

Web、Flutter、iOS、macOS、Android 与 Windows 共用语义规范。导航、权限、文字缩放、窗口与辅助技术采用宿主平台的行为。

原生组件库 SDK

Prototype · 三端首批 14 项已实现，含本地示例与构建测试。其余 47 项为 Draft；Beta 仍须完成辅助技术与设备验收。

Flutter、Compose、SwiftUI 首批各 14 个本地组件已实现； 构建记录可查，当前为 Prototype，尚未发布。

参考源码与平台下载
适配优先级

首先选平台原生语义控件，再应用 Rosemary 颜色、排版与必要几何。不要移除系统返回、文字缩放或辅助技术。系统对话框和权限界面保留原生结构；网页示例不模拟硬件实现完成。
